---
title: "Region x time with texts and an Abrahamic term"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
---

Both added terms together: groups and texts, as in `15_texts.Rmd`, with the Abrahamic term of `14_abrahamic.Rmd`.
Same window, questions and main model as `13_main.Rmd`:

```
answer_value ~ 0 + region + region:time + text + abrahamic + (1 | expert)
```

- **`text`** and **`abrahamic`** are level differences in log-odds, at the same region, time and expert; both have a
  normal(0, 2) prior, as in `14_abrahamic.Rmd` and `15_texts.Rmd`. Other priors as in `13_main.Rmd`.
- **The two terms add up:** an Abrahamic text differs from a non-Abrahamic group by the sum of both. The model does
  not let the text difference depend on Abrahamic status (checked visually at the end).
- **Texts add entries that break the "Abrahamic = from 0 CE" pattern:** Abrahamic texts before 0 CE and
  non-Abrahamic texts from 0 CE (table under "Data"). The Abrahamic term should be better separated from time than in
  `14_abrahamic.Rmd`.
- **Comparisons:**
  - the average slopes of all four models (main, Abrahamic, texts, both): which trends hold in all of them;
  - the coefficients against the models with only one of the terms;
  - the region slopes and a leave-one-out comparison against `15_texts.Rmd` (same observations).

Run from inside `modeling/` after `3_prepare_data.py`, `13_main.Rmd`, `14_abrahamic.Rmd` and `15_texts.Rmd` (their
fits are the comparisons). Fits are saved in `fits/` (`combined_*`; delete them to refit), figures in
`fig/texts_abrahamic/`.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(posterior)
library(loo)

options(mc.cores = 4, brms.backend = "cmdstanr")
dir.create("fits", showWarnings = FALSE)
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 11))

# figures: shown in the session and saved as fig/texts_abrahamic/<name>.jpg
fig_dir <- "fig/texts_abrahamic"
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
save_plot <- function(p, name, width, height) {
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(name, ".jpg")), p, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
  p
}

regions <- c("Southwest Asia", "Europe", "Africa", "East Asia")
model_colors <- c(
  "main (13, groups)" = "#a3a29b",
  "Abrahamic term (14, groups)" = "#8a63d2",
  "texts (15, groups and texts)" = "#2a78d6",
  "both (16, groups and texts)" = "#d95f02"
)
abrahamic_colors <- c("not Abrahamic" = "#52514e", "Abrahamic" = "#8a63d2")
year_min <- -3000
year_max <- 1500

# child questions combined into one ("Yes" if any answered question in the set is "Yes"), as in 13_main.Rmd
groups <- list(
  "murder out-group" = c("murder other religions", "murder other polities"),
  "elite ties" = c("is monarch fused", "is monarch manifestation", "is kin to elites", "other elite loyalty")
)
```

# Data

Same as `15_texts.Rmd`.

```{r data, message = FALSE}
source_of <- read_csv("../data/sccsrv3/entry_data.csv", col_select = c(entry_id, data_source)) |>
  distinct(entry_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

d_window <- read_csv("data/model_data.csv") |>
  left_join(source_of, by = "entry_id") |>
  filter(
    poll %in% c("group", "text"),
    world_region %in% regions,
    is.na(data_source) | (data_source != "eHRAF" & !str_starts(data_source, "Pulotu")),
    year_from >= year_min, year_from < year_max
  ) |>
  mutate(region = factor(world_region, levels = regions), time = year_from / 1000, text = as.integer(poll == "text"))

# conflicting answers (Yes and No for the same entry and question; weight < 1) are left out
d <- d_window |> filter(weight == 1)

# parent question of each family of child questions
parent_of <- c(monitoring = "supernatural monitoring present", shg = "supreme high god present")

# child questions in topic order (as in 4_baseline.Rmd), before grouping
topic_items <- c(
  "murder coreligionists", "murder other religions", "murder other polities", "non-lethal fighting",
  "prosocial norm adherence", "lying", "honouring oaths", "property crimes", "economic fairness",
  "gossiping", "laziness", "shirking risk", "disrespecting elders", "sex",
  "ritual observance", "performance of rituals", "taboos", "personal hygiene", "sorcery",
  "conversion non-religionists",
  "knowledge this world", "causal efficacy the world", "indirect causal efficacy the world", "communicates with living",
  "is unquestionably good", "positive emotion", "negative emotion",
  "is anthropomorphic", "possesses hunger", "is sky deity", "is chthonic",
  "permissible to worship other god?",
  "is monarch fused", "is monarch manifestation", "is kin to elites", "other elite loyalty"
)
stopifnot(setequal(topic_items, d |> filter(family != "parent") |> distinct(question_short) |> pull()))

# child questions after grouping: each set takes the place of its first question
items <- enframe(groups, name = "group", value = "question_short") |> unnest(question_short)
group_of <- setNames(items$group, items$question_short)  # question -> its set
topic_order <- unique(coalesce(unname(group_of[topic_items]), topic_items))
all_questions <- c(unname(parent_of), topic_order)

# child questions as answered; grouped sets collapsed to one answer per entry
children <- d |> filter(question_short %in% topic_items, !inferred)
grouped <- children |>
  filter(question_short %in% names(group_of)) |>
  mutate(group = unname(group_of[question_short])) |>
  group_by(question_short = group, family, entry_id, entry_name, expert, region, year_from, time, poll, text,
           abrahamic) |>
  summarise(answer_value = as.integer(any(answer_value == 1)), .groups = "drop")

# samples (one model per question in each)
sets <- list(
  parent = d |> filter(question_short %in% parent_of), # as answered (no "No" inferred for the supreme high god since 2026-11-23)
  conditional = bind_rows(children |> filter(!question_short %in% names(group_of)), grouped)
)
runs <- bind_rows(
  tibble(set = "parent", question = unname(parent_of)),
  tibble(set = "conditional", question = topic_order)
)

questions <- bind_rows(sets) |> distinct(family, question_short)
stopifnot(setequal(topic_order, filter(questions, family != "parent")$question_short))
```

Entries by poll, before and from 0 CE (start year), Abrahamic or not. The cells that break the pattern (Abrahamic
before 0 CE, not Abrahamic from 0 CE) separate the Abrahamic term from time:

```{r data_pattern}
d_window |>
  distinct(entry_id, poll, year_from, abrahamic) |>
  mutate(period = if_else(year_from < 0, "before 0 CE", "from 0 CE"),
         abrahamic = if_else(abrahamic == 1, "Abrahamic", "not_Abrahamic")) |>
  count(poll, period, abrahamic) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = abrahamic, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
```

The same by region:

```{r data_pattern_region}
d_window |>
  distinct(entry_id, poll, region, year_from, abrahamic) |>
  mutate(period = if_else(year_from < 0, "before 0 CE", "from 0 CE"),
         abrahamic = if_else(abrahamic == 1, "Abrahamic", "not_Abrahamic")) |>
  count(region, poll, period, abrahamic) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = abrahamic, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

Abrahamic texts before 0 CE:

```{r data_abrahamic_bce}
d_window |>
  filter(poll == "text", abrahamic == 1, year_from < 0) |>
  distinct(entry_id, entry_name, region, year_from, expert) |>
  arrange(year_from) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

# Model and fit

The model is compiled once (`chains = 0`) and then refit for each question with `update()`.

```{r fit, message = FALSE, results = "hide"}
model <- bf(answer_value ~ 0 + region + region:time + text + abrahamic + (1 | expert))

# brms names the region coefficients without spaces (regionSouthwestAsia, regionSouthwestAsia:time, ...)
region_key <- setNames(regions, str_remove_all(regions, " "))
priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),  # region slopes
  reduce(map(paste0("region", names(region_key)), ~ set_prior("normal(0, 1.5)", class = "b", coef = .x)), c),
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = "b", coef = "text"),
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = "b", coef = "abrahamic"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "sd")  # half-normal on the expert SD
)

template <- suppressWarnings(brm(model, data = sets$parent, family = bernoulli(), prior = priors,
                                 chains = 0, refresh = 0, silent = 2))

fit_question <- function(set, question) {
  path <- sprintf("fits/combined_%s_%s.rds", set, question)
  if (file.exists(path)) return(readRDS(path))
  fit <- update(
    template,
    newdata = filter(sets[[set]], question_short == question),
    chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 2000, seed = 125123, refresh = 0,
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99)
  )
  saveRDS(fit, path)
  fit
}

# fits of the earlier models: main (13), Abrahamic term (14), texts (15)
read_fit <- function(prefix, rmd) {
  function(set, question) {
    path <- sprintf("fits/%s_%s_%s.rds", prefix, set, question)
    if (!file.exists(path)) stop("missing ", path, ": run ", rmd, " first")
    readRDS(path)
  }
}

fits <- runs |>
  mutate(
    fit = map2(set, question, fit_question),
    fit_main = map2(set, question, read_fit("main_region_time", "13_main.Rmd")),
    fit_abrahamic = map2(set, question, read_fit("abrahamic", "14_abrahamic.Rmd")),
    fit_texts = map2(set, question, read_fit("texts", "15_texts.Rmd"))
  )
```

# Diagnostics

```{r diagnostics}
diagnostics <- fits |>
  mutate(diag = map(fit, function(fit) {
    s <- summarise_draws(as_draws_df(fit, variable = "^(b|sd)_", regex = TRUE))
    tibble(
      max_rhat = max(s$rhat),
      min_ess_bulk = min(s$ess_bulk),
      min_ess_tail = min(s$ess_tail),
      divergences = sum(subset(nuts_params(fit), Parameter == "divergent__")$Value)
    )
  })) |>
  select(set, question, diag) |>
  unnest(diag)

diagnostics |>
  summarise(max_rhat = max(max_rhat), min_ess_bulk = min(min_ess_bulk), min_ess_tail = min(min_ess_tail),
            divergences = sum(divergences))

# fits with any problem
diagnostics |> filter(max_rhat > 1.01 | min_ess_bulk < 400 | min_ess_tail < 400 | divergences > 0)
```

# Estimates

```{r estimates}
summarise_draws_ <- function(value) {
  tibble(mean = mean(value), lower = quantile(value, 0.025), upper = quantile(value, 0.975), p_positive = mean(value > 0))
}

# region slopes per draw, plus their average
region_slopes <- function(fit) {
  draws <- as_draws_df(fit, variable = "^b_region.*:time$", regex = TRUE) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    select(.draw, starts_with("b_")) |>
    pivot_longer(-.draw, values_to = "value") |>
    mutate(region = unname(region_key[str_remove(str_remove(name, "^b_region"), ":time$")])) |>
    select(.draw, region, value)
  average <- draws |> group_by(.draw) |> summarise(value = mean(value)) |> mutate(region = "average")
  bind_rows(draws, average)
}

add_panels <- function(est) {
  est |>
    left_join(questions, by = c("question" = "question_short")) |>
    mutate(
      panel = case_when(set == "parent" ~ "parent", family == "monitoring" ~ "monitoring", TRUE ~ "supreme\nhigh god"),
      panel = factor(panel, levels = c("parent", "monitoring", "supreme\nhigh god")),
      question = factor(question, levels = rev(all_questions))
    )
}

model_names <- c(fit_main = "main (13, groups)", fit_abrahamic = "Abrahamic term (14, groups)",
                 fit_texts = "texts (15, groups and texts)", fit = "both (16, groups and texts)")

# slopes in all four models
slopes <- fits |>
  pivot_longer(c(fit_main, fit_abrahamic, fit_texts, fit), names_to = "model", values_to = "fit") |>
  mutate(
    model = factor(unname(model_names[model]), levels = names(model_colors)),
    est = map(fit, ~ region_slopes(.x) |> group_by(region) |> reframe(summarise_draws_(value)))
  ) |>
  select(model, set, question, est) |>
  unnest(est) |>
  add_panels() |>
  mutate(region = factor(region, levels = c("average", regions)))

# text and Abrahamic coefficients, in the model with both and in the model with only that term
coefficient <- function(fit, term) summarise_draws_(as_draws_df(fit, variable = paste0("b_", term))[[paste0("b_", term)]])
coefficients <- bind_rows(
  fits |> transmute(set, question, term = "text", model = model_names[["fit_texts"]],
                    est = map(fit_texts, coefficient, "text")),
  fits |> transmute(set, question, term = "text", model = model_names[["fit"]], est = map(fit, coefficient, "text")),
  fits |> transmute(set, question, term = "abrahamic", model = model_names[["fit_abrahamic"]],
                    est = map(fit_abrahamic, coefficient, "abrahamic")),
  fits |> transmute(set, question, term = "abrahamic", model = model_names[["fit"]],
                    est = map(fit, coefficient, "abrahamic"))
) |>
  unnest(est) |>
  add_panels() |>
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = names(model_colors)),
         term = factor(if_else(term == "text", "texts vs. groups", "Abrahamic vs. other"),
                       levels = c("texts vs. groups", "Abrahamic vs. other")))

# expert SD in all four models
expert_sd <- fits |>
  pivot_longer(c(fit_main, fit_abrahamic, fit_texts, fit), names_to = "model", values_to = "fit") |>
  mutate(model = unname(model_names[model]),
         sd = map_dbl(fit, ~ mean(as_draws_df(.x, variable = "sd_expert__Intercept")$sd_expert__Intercept))) |>
  select(question, model, sd)
```

## Coefficients: alone and together

Text and Abrahamic coefficients in the model with both terms, and in the model with only that term (mean and 95%
interval, log-odds). Dashed: ±2, one prior SD.

```{r coefficients, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 10}
p_coef <- ggplot(coefficients, aes(mean, question, colour = model, group = fct_rev(model))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-2, 2), colour = "grey80", linetype = "22") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 0.15) +
  facet_grid(panel ~ term, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = model_colors) +
  labs(x = "Difference (log-odds)", y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0))
save_plot(p_coef, "coefficients", 11, 10)
```

## Average of the region slopes: all four models

```{r slopes_average, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 13}
slope_plot <- function(est, dodge = 0.7) {
  ggplot(est, aes(mean, question, colour = model, group = fct_rev(model))) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
    geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), position = position_dodge(width = dodge), size = 0.12) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = model_colors) +
    labs(x = "Time slope (log-odds per 1,000 years)", y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2)) +
    theme(legend.position = "top", strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0))
}
p_average <- slope_plot(filter(slopes, region == "average")) +
  facet_grid(panel ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y")
save_plot(p_average, "slopes_average", 9, 13)
```

Per question: average slope in each model, as mean and probability of a positive slope; `*` marks a 95% interval
that excludes zero. `credible` counts the models in which the slope is credible (out of 4), with its direction.

```{r slopes_table}
short <- c("main (13, groups)" = "main", "Abrahamic term (14, groups)" = "abrahamic",
           "texts (15, groups and texts)" = "texts", "both (16, groups and texts)" = "both")
average <- slopes |>
  filter(region == "average") |>
  mutate(model = unname(short[as.character(model)]),
         credible = lower > 0 | upper < 0,
         value = sprintf("%.2f%s (%.3f)", mean, if_else(credible, "*", " "), p_positive))
average |>
  group_by(question) |>
  mutate(n_credible = sum(credible),
         direction = case_when(all(mean[credible] > 0) & n_credible > 0 ~ "+",
                               all(mean[credible] < 0) & n_credible > 0 ~ "-", n_credible == 0 ~ "", TRUE ~ "+/-"),
         credible = paste0(n_credible, direction)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(question, model, value, credible) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = value) |>
  mutate(question = factor(question, levels = all_questions)) |>
  select(question, main, abrahamic, texts, both, credible) |>
  arrange(question) |>
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

Number of credible average slopes per model:

```{r slopes_count}
average |>
  group_by(model = factor(model, levels = short)) |>
  summarise(positive = sum(credible & mean > 0), negative = sum(credible & mean < 0))
```

Expert SD (posterior mean) in each model:

```{r expert_sd}
expert_sd |>
  mutate(model = unname(short[model]), sd = round(sd, 2)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = sd) |>
  mutate(question = factor(question, levels = all_questions)) |>
  arrange(question) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

## Slopes per region: texts and both

Adding the Abrahamic term to `15_texts.Rmd`. East Asia has one Abrahamic group and one Abrahamic text, so its slopes
should barely change.

```{r slopes_region, fig.width = 16, fig.height = 12}
p_region <- slope_plot(filter(slopes, region != "average", model %in% names(model_colors)[3:4]), dodge = 0.6) +
  facet_grid(panel ~ region, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y")
save_plot(p_region, "slopes_region", 16, 12)
```

## Does the Abrahamic term improve prediction?

Leave-one-out comparison (elpd) of the model with both terms against `15_texts.Rmd` (same observations), per
question. Positive: better with the Abrahamic term; a difference of less than about 2 standard errors is not a clear
difference. `high_k`: observations with Pareto k > 0.7 in the model with both terms.

```{r loo, warning = FALSE}
# elpd of model a minus elpd of model b, as "diff (se)", from the pointwise values (as loo_compare does)
elpd_vs <- function(a, b) {
  d <- a$pointwise[, "elpd_loo"] - b$pointwise[, "elpd_loo"]
  sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", sum(d), sqrt(length(d)) * sd(d))
}

# one core: forking for each of the small fits can exhaust processes ("unable to fork"), and gains nothing
fits |>
  mutate(
    loo = map(fit, ~ loo(.x, cores = 1)),
    loo_texts = map(fit_texts, ~ loo(.x, cores = 1))
  ) |>
  transmute(
    question = factor(question, levels = all_questions),
    n = map_int(fit, ~ nrow(.x$data)),
    both_vs_texts = map2_chr(loo, loo_texts, elpd_vs),
    high_k = map_int(loo, ~ sum(pareto_k_values(.x) > 0.7))
  ) |>
  arrange(question) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

# Curves over time: by poll and Abrahamic status

Check of the model's assumption that the four kinds of entries share the trend and differ in level only, with the
text difference the same for Abrahamic and other entries.

- **Lines:** the typical region (average region intercept and slope), averaged over experts as in `13_main.Rmd`;
  colour: Abrahamic (purple) or not (grey); solid: groups, dashed: texts. Bands: 95% intervals. Each line is drawn
  over the years where its entries have data for the question (first to last start year).
- **Points:** observed share "Yes" in 500-year bins of start year, all four regions pooled; circles: groups,
  triangles: texts; size = number of entries. The four are shifted slightly around the bin midpoint.

```{r curves}
years <- seq(year_min, year_max, by = 50)
kinds <- expand_grid(abrahamic = c(0L, 1L), text = c(0L, 1L)) |>
  mutate(status = names(abrahamic_colors)[abrahamic + 1], poll = c("groups", "texts")[text + 1],
         kind = paste(status, poll))
answers <- bind_rows(sets, .id = "set") |>
  transmute(set, question = question_short, entry_id, year_from, answer_value, abrahamic, text) |>
  left_join(kinds, by = c("abrahamic", "text"))

# P(yes) averaged over experts: per draw (row of eta), mean of logit^-1(eta + sigma * z) over standard-normal quantiles z
z <- qnorm(ppoints(25))
expert_average <- function(eta, sigma) Reduce(`+`, lapply(z, function(zk) plogis(eta + sigma * zk))) / length(z)
eta_grid <- function(a, b) outer(a, rep(1, length(years))) + outer(b, years / 1000)  # draws x years

curves <- fits |>
  mutate(curve = map(fit, function(fit) {
    draws <- as_draws_df(fit) |> as_tibble()
    a <- rowMeans(as.matrix(draws[paste0("b_region", names(region_key))]))
    b <- rowMeans(as.matrix(draws[paste0("b_region", names(region_key), ":time")]))
    pmap_dfr(kinds, function(abrahamic, text, status, poll, kind) {
      p <- expert_average(eta_grid(a + abrahamic * draws$b_abrahamic + text * draws$b_text, b),
                          draws$sd_expert__Intercept)
      tibble(status, poll, kind, year = years, mean = colMeans(p),
             lo95 = apply(p, 2, quantile, 0.025), hi95 = apply(p, 2, quantile, 0.975))
    })
  })) |>
  select(set, question, curve) |>
  unnest(curve)

# each line over the years where its entries have data
data_range <- answers |>
  group_by(set, question, kind) |>
  summarise(from = floor(min(year_from) / 50) * 50, to = ceiling(max(year_from) / 50) * 50, .groups = "drop")
curves <- curves |>
  inner_join(data_range, by = c("set", "question", "kind")) |>
  filter(year >= from, year <= to)

# observed share per kind in 500-year bins of start year
bin_edges <- seq(year_min, year_max, by = 500)
offsets <- setNames(c(-75, -25, 25, 75), kinds$kind)
binned <- answers |>
  mutate(bin = findInterval(year_from, bin_edges)) |>
  group_by(set, question, status, poll, kind, bin) |>
  summarise(share = mean(answer_value), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(year = bin_edges[bin] + 250 + offsets[kind])

kind_plot <- function(questions_, ncol = 6) {
  keep <- function(x) filter(x, question %in% questions_) |> mutate(question = factor(question, levels = questions_))
  lines <- keep(curves)
  ggplot(mapping = aes(year)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(0, 1), colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_ribbon(data = lines, aes(ymin = lo95, ymax = hi95, fill = status, group = kind), alpha = 0.12,
                show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_point(data = keep(binned), aes(y = share, colour = status, shape = poll, size = n), alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_line(data = lines, aes(y = mean, colour = status, linetype = poll, group = kind), linewidth = 0.9) +
    facet_wrap(~ question, ncol = ncol) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = abrahamic_colors) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = abrahamic_colors) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(groups = 16, texts = 17)) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(groups = "solid", texts = "22")) +
    scale_size_area(max_size = 4, breaks = c(1, 5, 10, 20, 40)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(year_min, year_max, by = 1000)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1), xlim = c(year_min, year_max)) +
    labs(x = "Year (start year)", y = "P(yes)", colour = NULL, shape = NULL, linetype = NULL, size = "entries") +
    theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7))
}

monitoring_questions <- c(parent_of[["monitoring"]], intersect(topic_order, filter(questions, family == "monitoring")$question_short))
shg_questions <- c(parent_of[["shg"]], intersect(topic_order, filter(questions, family == "shg")$question_short))
```

